*Source: [Ultimate Spheres of Power](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/300249/Ultimate-Spheres-of-Power?affiliate_id=549120)*

### Casting

At 4th level, the sphere paladin may combine spheres and talents to create magical effects. The sphere paladin is considered a Low-Caster. (Note: All casters gain 2 bonus talents and a casting tradition the first time they gain the casting class feature.)

This replaces the spells class feature.

### Spell Pool

The sphere paladin gains a small reservoir of energy she can call on to create truly wondrous effects, called a spell pool. This pool contains a number of spell points equal to her class level + her casting ability modifier (minimum 1). This pool replenishes once per day after roughly 8 hours of rest.

### Magic Talents

A sphere paladin gains one magic talent at 4th level and every 2 levels thereafter.
